title:
Avoid implied

tags in collection cache test
body:
### Motivation / Background Fixes #58825. `CollectionCacheTest` fails with libxml2 2.15 because it expected implied `

` tags that the HTML parser no longer inserts. ### Detail This Pull Request changes the assertion to check the collection text and order instead of an HTML snapshot. That still covers the original behavior and passes on both libxml2 2.13 and 2.15. ### Additional information Test-only. No runtime change. ### Checklist Before submitting the PR make sure the following are checked: * [x] This Pull Request is related to one change. Unrelated changes should be opened in separate PRs. * [x] Commit message has a detailed description of what changed and why. If this PR fixes a related issue include it in the commit message. Ex: `[Fix #issue-number]` * [x] Tests are added or updated if you fix a bug or add a feature. * [x] CHANGELOG files are updated for the changed libraries if there is a behavior change or additional feature. Minor bug fixes and documentation changes should not be included.
